C-QA-LOCAL-TAURI-TOOL.PreparedToolContract: Use only Node built-ins. Before creating build configuration, invoking a build or writing registry data, parse package.json, package-lock.json and installed node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/package.json. Require supported lockfileVersion 3, identical manifest/root-lock CLI declarations, a canonical locked release version, valid SHA-512 integrity metadata and matching installed name/version. Require the locked version to satisfy the supported canonical exact, caret or tilde declaration; reject malformed, unsupported or incoherent forms. Lock metadata identifies the prepared package; do not claim that comparing package metadata verifies all installed file bytes against the tarball digest. Require a tauri entry in both lock and installed bin metadata, normalize their relative spellings, reject absolute/traversal entries, resolve real paths and require the same regular JavaScript file beneath the real installed package directory. The package directory itself must resolve beneath this worktree's real node_modules directory. Do not use PATH tool resolution, load candidate package code during validation, install anything or fall back on any executor. Missing or incompatible layout fails visibly.
C-QA-LOCAL-TAURI-TOOL.InvocationContract: Call the checked entry through process.execPath with [entry, 'build', '--debug', '--config', confPath], existing repository cwd and inherited stdio. Preserve cleanup in finally, child failure propagation and the order that prevents failed builds from appending registry records. Preserve source SHA, isolated product and bundle identity, updater-artifacts-off merge, platform targets, digest, output discovery, optional smoke and registry behavior. Help and dry-run return before local dependency checks and before configuration creation/build/recording. No actual build is required as a security probe.
C-QA-LOCAL-TAURI-TOOL.EnvironmentContract: Construct buildEnvironment from an empty object by copying only documented exact runtime/toolchain names. Runtime names: PATH, HOME, USERPROFILE, USER, LOGNAME, TMPDIR, TMP, TEMP, LANG, LC_ALL, LC_CTYPE, SystemRoot, WINDIR, COMSPEC, PATHEXT, SystemDrive, LOCALAPPDATA and APPDATA. Toolchain names: CARGO_HOME, RUSTUP_HOME, RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN, DEVELOPER_DIR, SDKROOT, MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET, CC, CXX, AR, CFLAGS, CXXFLAGS, CPPFLAGS, LDFLAGS, LIB, INCLUDE, LIBPATH, WindowsSdkDir, WindowsSDKVersion, UniversalCRTSdkDir, UCRTVersion, VCToolsInstallDir, VCINSTALLDIR and VSINSTALLDIR. Handle Windows environment names case-insensitively without duplicating aliases; deterministic fixtures cover their canonical output. Do not forward NODE_OPTIONS, arbitrary prefix-matched names, registry tokens, cloud/GitHub/Apple/updater credentials, signing identities or wrapper injection variables. The allowlist is environment minimization for trusted prepared tools; it does not confine filesystem access or promise protection against malicious dependencies. Do not alter output-location or smoke process selection under this change.
C-QA-LOCAL-TAURI-TOOL.FixtureDesign: Use temporary synthetic repositories and inert local Node CLI fixtures. Inject process/filesystem boundaries where needed to prove zero build calls and unchanged registry on rejection without invoking a native build, registry acquisition, external network or real credentials. Test direct child argv/cwd, preserved merge configuration, exact invocation count and a dummy ambient secret excluded from captured environment. Cover absent package/entry, bad JSON and shapes, lock-root mismatch, version/range/integrity problems, mismatched installed metadata, unsafe bin paths and realpath/symlink escape, non-file entries, child failure, dependency-free help and both dry-run targets. Symlink tests may use an injected realpath boundary where host policy disallows creating links; they must still exercise the containment decision and may not become successful skips. Preserve registry bytes and generated README survey; tests must prove these invariants.
C-QA-LOCAL-TAURI-TOOL.CommandBudgets: On the integrated reference source, the two existing suites passed 33 tests in 4.76 seconds. Syntax and both dry-runs completed successfully without building or recording. The new suite does not yet exist and has no claimed measured result. Allocate 30 seconds for the combined focused gate, with inert child startup bounded by fixtures; each syntax/dry-run leaf has 5 seconds. If implementation cannot meet these measured-budget assumptions, report it before plan approval or execution; do not silently change an approved gate. Full hosted matrix/toolchain startup belongs to acceptance, not nested lifecycle assertions.
